aboutInfo.name: Cristian Florez
aboutInfo.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
aboutInfo.headline: Full-stack engineer building secure, reliable platforms for government and finance — now shipped with AI-native workflows.
aboutInfo.bio: For 6+ years I've shipped production web applications end to end, from React and Angular frontends to .NET Core, Node.js and Java backends, for Colombia's Supreme Court, one of the country's largest banks and small businesses. I turn complex, highly regulated processes into simple, dependable products, working directly with judges and business analysts to get requirements right the first time. Based in Toronto, I'm deepening my backend work at Humber Polytechnic and building with Claude, Copilot and agentic, spec-driven workflows.
aboutInfo.focus: Database design, performance tuning and end-to-end feature ownership

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
experience.company: Supreme Court of Justice of Colombia
experience.description: Owned the Court's judicial workflow platform end to end — from architecture and database design through deployment — spanning case management, public search and the institutional website.
achievements: Cut average case processing time from 4 months to 10 days by systematizing 80%+ of court workflows in ESAV.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema, built .NET Core backend modules and implemented the full CRUD workflow.
Cut public document search from minutes to milliseconds by redesigning indexing and queries across 500,000+ legal records.
Led architecture discussions and UX trade-offs with magistrates and judges; containerized with Docker and improved CI.

Implemented financial-history verification and customer risk-analysis logic under strict regulatory requirements.
